units.source_text: 胧月夜狼狈之极，只得膝行而前，来到寝台外面。

en.t: Oborozukiyo was utterly flustered and could only crawl forward on her knees until she reached the outside of the bed curtains.

units.source_text: 右大臣看见她红晕满颊，以为患病发烧，便对她说：

en.t: Seeing her cheeks flushed red, the Minister of the Right thought she was ill with fever and said to her:

units.source_text: “怎么你的气色还不正常？

en.t: Why is your complexion still not right?

units.source_text: 想是妖魔作祟吧，法事应该延长日子。”

en.t: It must be the work of some evil spirit; the rites should be extended for more days.

units.source_text: 这时候他看见一条淡紫红色的男带缠绕在女儿身上，觉得很奇怪。

en.t: Just then he saw a pale purplish-red man's sash wrapped around his daughter and found it very strange.

units.source_text: 又看见一张写着诗歌的怀纸落在帷屏旁边，心念这是什么东西，吃了一惊，便问：

en.t: He also saw a sheet of folded paper with a poem written on it lying beside the curtain screen; wondering what it was, he was startled and asked:

units.source_text: “这是谁的？

en.t: Whose is this?

units.source_text: 这东西很奇怪。

en.t: This is very suspicious.

units.source_text: 拿过来，让我看看究竟是谁的东西。”

en.t: Bring it here and let me see whose thing it really is.

units.source_text: 胧月夜回头一看，方才发现。

en.t: Oborozukiyo turned to look back and only then noticed it.

units.source_text: 但此时已无法抵赖，有什么话可回答呢？

en.t: But by now there was no way to deny it, and what could she possibly say in reply?

units.source_text: 吓得魂不附体。

en.t: She was so terrified that she nearly lost her soul.

units.source_text: 倘是身份高贵的人，应该体谅做女儿的此时一定怕羞，因而有所顾忌。

en.t: If he had been a person of noble refinement, he would have understood that his daughter must be overwhelmed with shame at such a moment and would have shown some restraint.

units.source_text: 无奈这位大臣秉性急躁，毫不留情。

en.t: Unfortunately, this minister was by nature impatient and showed no mercy at all.

units.source_text: 他并不思前想后，愤然地走上前来，拾了那张怀纸，

en.t: Without thinking things through, he strode forward in anger and picked up the folded paper,

units.source_text: 趁此向帷屏后面探望一下。

en.t: and took the opportunity to peer behind the curtain screen.

units.source_text: 但见一个体态非常优美的男子，肆无忌惮地躺在女儿铺位旁边，

en.t: There he saw a man of extraordinarily graceful figure lying brazenly beside his daughter's bedding,

units.source_text: 此时方才慢慢地拉过衣服来遮住颜面，算是躲避了。

en.t: and only then did the man slowly pull his robe over to cover his face, as if that counted as hiding.

units.source_text: 右大臣惊得发呆，一时怒火中烧。

en.t: The Minister of the Right was stunned speechless, and in an instant anger blazed up within him.

units.source_text: 然而到底不便当面揭穿，气得头昏眼花，只得拿了那张怀纸回正房去。

en.t: Yet in the end he could not expose them to their faces; dizzy with rage, he could only take the folded paper and return to the main room.

units.source_text: 胧月夜呆若木鸡，差点儿没吓死。

en.t: Oborozukiyo stood frozen like a wooden figure, almost frightened to death.

units.source_text: 源氏大将懊丧之余，想道：

en.t: General Genji, sunk in remorse, thought to himself:

units.source_text: “恶贯满盈，终于要受世人非难了！”

en.t: My wickedness has finally reached its limit; now I will be condemned by the world!

units.source_text: 然而看了这女人的可怜之状，只得胡乱安慰她一番。

en.t: But seeing the woman's pitiful state, he had no choice but to comfort her as best he could.
